Name: Eemie's Victorian Buildings for CP
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A set of Victorian era buildings. Choose from three versions, now with seasonal version.
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

A conversion of Eemie's Victorian Era Buildings to Content Patcher.  Configurable for both versions.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Eemie's Victorian Buildings' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once using SMAPI to generate the config file.

5.  Choose your version; defaults to clean.  You're done!
Config Options

*   Choose between Clean, Mossy, or Seasonal.  Defaults to Clean.
